# AutoSuggestBox

Header: `winui/ui/text/AutoSuggestBox.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/text/AutoSuggestBox.hpp`.

A text box with a floating list of suggestions the app supplies as the user types, for search boxes and type-ahead pickers.

The control never filters. Handle [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed), and when the reason is AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason::UserInput, compute the matches and pass them to [set_suggestions()](#set_suggestions). The popup opens whenever the box is focused and the list is non-empty.

Up and Down preview suggestions in the text. Stepping past either end restores what the user typed. A row click, or Enter on a highlighted row, fires [on_suggestion_chosen()](#on_suggestion_chosen). Enter or a row click fires [on_query_submitted()](#on_query_submitted). Escape restores the typed text and closes the list. An optional query button ([set_query_icon()](#set_query_icon)) submits the typed text as a query.

Example: 
```cpp
static const std::vector<std::string> Cities{"Amsterdam", "Berlin", "Bern", "Zurich"};

auto box = std::make_unique<ui::AutoSuggestBoxControl>();
box->set_header("City");
box->set_placeholder_text("Search cities");
box->set_query_icon(ui::symbol_glyph(ui::Symbol::Find));
box->on_text_changed([b = box.get()](const ui::AutoSuggestBoxTextChangedArgs& args) {
    if (args.reason != ui::AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason::UserInput)
        return; // our own preview/revert writes; nothing to re-filter
    std::vector<std::string> matches;
    for (const std::string& city : Cities)
        if (!args.text.empty() && city.starts_with(args.text))
            matches.push_back(city);
    b->set_suggestions(std::move(matches));
});
box->on_query_submitted([](const ui::AutoSuggestBoxQuerySubmittedArgs& args) {
    // args.chosen_suggestion is unset for a free-typed query
});
window.set_content(std::move(box));
```

## `ui::AutoSuggestBox`

A search field with a live suggestion list. Builds a [ui::AutoSuggestBoxControl](#uiautosuggestboxcontrol).

Usually [`.suggestions`](#uiautosuggestbox-suggestions) is bound to a property, [`.on_text_changed`](#uiautosuggestbox-on_text_changed) recomputes it as the user types, and [`.on_query_submitted`](#uiautosuggestbox-on_query_submitted) runs the search.

Example: 
```cpp
const std::vector<std::string>         titles{"Inbox", "Invoices", "Settings"};
ui::Property<std::vector<std::string>> matches;

window.set_content(ui::AutoSuggestBox{
    .placeholder_text = "Search",
    .suggestions      = matches,
    .query_icon       = ui::symbol_glyph(ui::Symbol::Find),
    .width            = 300.0f,
    .on_text_changed  =
        [&](const ui::AutoSuggestBoxTextChangedArgs& args)
    {
        if (args.reason == ui::AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason::UserInput)
        {
            std::vector<std::string> found;
            for (const std::string& title : titles)
            {
                if (title.starts_with(args.text))
                {
                    found.push_back(title);
                }
            }
            matches = std::move(found);
        }
    },
    .on_query_submitted = [](const ui::AutoSuggestBoxQuerySubmittedArgs& args)
    { std::println("Search for {}", args.query_text); },
});
```

## `ui::AutoSuggestBoxControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::ValueProvider`.

A text box with a floating list of suggestions the app supplies as the user types, for search boxes and type-ahead pickers.

The control never filters. Handle [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed), and when the reason is AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason::UserInput, compute the matches and pass them to [set_suggestions()](#set_suggestions). The popup opens whenever the box is focused and the list is non-empty.

Up and Down preview suggestions in the text. Stepping past either end restores what the user typed. A row click, or Enter on a highlighted row, fires [on_suggestion_chosen()](#on_suggestion_chosen). Enter or a row click fires [on_query_submitted()](#on_query_submitted). Escape restores the typed text and closes the list. An optional query button ([set_query_icon()](#set_query_icon)) submits the typed text as a query.

### AutoSuggestBoxControl

```cpp
AutoSuggestBoxControl()
```

An empty box with no suggestions, header or query button.

### AutoSuggestBoxControl

```cpp
AutoSuggestBoxControl(std::string text)
```

A box starting with [`text`](#text), which is also what Escape reverts to until the user types.

### text

```cpp
const std::string& text() const
```

The text box's current text (UTF-8), including a previewed suggestion.

### set_text

```cpp
void set_text(std::string text)
```

Replaces the text and moves the caret to the end. Doesn't fire [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) or change the suggestion list. It also doesn't change the text Escape restores, which only the user's typing sets.

### suggestions

```cpp
const std::vector<std::string>& suggestions() const
```

The list last passed to [set_suggestions()](#set_suggestions), shown as-is in the popup.

### set_suggestions

```cpp
void set_suggestions(std::vector<std::string> suggestions)
```

Replaces the shown suggestion list and clears the hover and keyboard highlight. Opens the popup when the control is focused and the new list is non-empty. Otherwise [is_suggestion_list_open()](#is_suggestion_list_open) stays as it was.

### is_suggestion_list_open

```cpp
bool is_suggestion_list_open() const
```

Whether the suggestion popup is showing.


The query button's icon; empty for no button.

```cpp

```

Shows a query button with this icon (such as `Symbol::Find`); a click on it submits the typed text with no suggestion chosen. An empty source, the default, has no button.

The query button's rect in window DIPs, valid after arrange. Empty without a query icon.

### on_text_changed

```cpp
void on_text_changed(Callback<void(const AutoSuggestBoxTextChangedArgs&)> handler)
```

Fired after every change to the text, with the new text and the reason ([AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason](#autosuggestboxtextchangereason)). [set_text()](#set_text) doesn't fire it. When the reason is UserInput, filter the suggestions here and call [set_suggestions()](#set_suggestions).

### on_suggestion_chosen

```cpp
void on_suggestion_chosen(Callback<void(std::size_t)> handler)
```

Fires with the suggestion's index when the user picks it with a row click, or with Enter while an arrow key has it highlighted. A highlight alone doesn't fire it. That shows in [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) with the reason AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason::Suggestion. Fires right before [on_query_submitted()](#on_query_submitted), with the suggestion already in the box.

### on_query_submitted

```cpp
void on_query_submitted(Callback<void(const AutoSuggestBoxQuerySubmittedArgs&)> handler)
```

Fired on Enter, a query button click, or after [on_suggestion_chosen()](#on_suggestion_chosen) for a row click. It fires even with nothing highlighted, for a typed query with no chosen index. The popup closes afterward.

```cpp

```

Routes clicks to the text box, its delete button or the query button.

### covers_children_at

```cpp

```

Whether a part of this element drawn over its children is at `p` (a scroll bar over the content), so the element is hit there instead of a child. Default: false.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the header, the text box and the query button.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Focus is forwarded to the internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox); losing it closes the popup.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

Up/Down walk the suggestions, Enter submits, Escape reverts; other keys edit the text.

### text_override

```cpp
bool text_override(const TextInputEvent& text_event) override
```

Typed text goes to the internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) and fires [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed) with UserInput.

### draws_focus_ring

```cpp
bool draws_focus_ring() const override
```

None: the field shows focus with its accent border.

## struct AutoSuggestBoxTextChangedArgs

What an [AutoSuggestBox](#uiautosuggestbox)'s `on_text_changed` gets: the text and what changed it.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `const std::string&` |  | The text now in the box. |
| `reason` | `AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason` |  | UserInput is the one to update the suggestions on. |

## struct AutoSuggestBoxQuerySubmittedArgs

What `on_query_submitted` gets: the text, and the suggestion it came from, if any.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query_text` | `const std::string&` |  | The submitted text. |
| `chosen_suggestion` | `std::optional<std::size_t>` |  | The suggestion's index; unset for typed text. |

## Enumerations

### AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason

```cpp
enum class AutoSuggestBoxTextChangeReason
```

Why the text box's text changed. Lets an `on_text_changed` handler tell the user's typing, which is worth filtering suggestions for, apart from the text this control writes itself.

| Value | |
| --- | --- |
| `UserInput` | The user typed, deleted or pasted text. |
| `ProgrammaticChange` | Escape, or an arrow key past either end of the list, restored the typed text. |
| `Suggestion` | A suggestion was put in the box, by an arrow key or a click. |
